# Water Capital Wire

> A free daily read on the business of water for managers, investors and operators: capital, companies, technology, infrastructure and water security, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a lead story traced through the water cycle (source, treatment, use, reuse, discharge), briefs across the water economy, weekly spotlights on a company, a leader, a supplier, an innovation and an investor, a capital desk of deals and firms, a water atlas on stress, demand, infrastructure, emerging sectors and security, a watchlist of water equities, a project calculator and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [Abu Dhabi will put water investment on the UN agenda for the first time since 2023](https://watercapitalwire.com/): November 20, 2026. The UN Water Conference opens in Abu Dhabi on December 8, the first UN water summit since 2023, with investment for water as one of its six dialogues. It ends with a President's summary, not a negotiated text, so the deals signed around it matter most.
- [Capital: US water utilities keep consolidating as American Water and Essential near the finish line](https://watercapitalwire.com/#money)
- [Desalination: Veolia adds two Gulf desalination contracts worth nearly €200 million](https://watercapitalwire.com/#world)
- [Desalination: Cox wins the construction contract for Mexico's Rosarito desalination plant](https://watercapitalwire.com/#latam)
- [Regulation: Utilities still wait on EPA's final PFAS rule](https://watercapitalwire.com/#policy)
